thread:
maria: Following up from the postmortem — consolidated action items for the cross-region routing + TLS retry incident. I'll assign owners and timelines here.

maria: Incident summary: LB healthcheck + SNI mismatch caused the edge to route to an older cert in eu-west, triggering TLS fallback and a retry storm. Result: spike in 502s and cross-region retries.

maria: Action items (short):
- A1: Fix LB routing rule that prefers old backend pool on wip nodes — owner: sam — ETA: 48h
- A2: Add stricter SNI validation on edge->origin path (Envoy filter + tests) — owner: alex — ETA: 7d
- A3: Retry throttling / circuit breaker in client library — owner: devon — ETA: 72h
- A4: Canary + automated rollback for cert rollouts — owner: sre-lead — ETA: 10d

sam: Taking A1. Found the rule in the template: `match: host_suffix: svc-redwood.example -> backend: pool-old` — looks accidental. Will patch and push a hotfix.

alex: For A2, propose adding a SNI whitelist in envoy filter and unit tests. If infra cooperation is smooth I can do this in ~5d.

devon: A3: I'll add a token-bucket limiter to the retry middleware and a 5s backoff cap. Draft PR tomorrow.

sre-lead: A4: We'll add canary gating in the cert rollout job and tie it to perf/502 metrics. 10d seems safe.

maria: I've added these items to the postmortem GH issue #1422 and linked the runbook. Please paste PR links back here after you open them.

sam: quick note — deploying hotfix today 10:30 UTC. Will update when complete. :rocket:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started by sam at 2026-03-04T10:32:12Z

sam: hotfix applied. Observability shows ~85% drop in retries in eu-west. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/incident/1422

alex: ack. I'll start the Envoy filter RFC and ping infra for a canary host.

devon: PR for retry limiter opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789 — requesting review from @sre-lead

sre-lead: Reviewing PRs this afternoon. Also flagging a recurring pattern: cross-region LB failover + stale config crops up roughly every 6 months. We should add a periodic audit.

maria: Good call. New item A5: periodic LB config audit + automated drift detection — owner: infra-automation — ETA: 21d.

devon: adding unit tests to prevent the exact retry regression we saw (integration test that simulates failover + TLS fallback).

maria: Updated timelines in the GH issue. I'll run a 1-week check-in thread next Tuesday. If anyone needs to move ETA, update the GH issue and ping me. :white_check_mark:

alex: noted.

sre-lead: tagging oncall rotation — please include these checks in the post-incident runbook (cert rollout checklist + SNI validation).

maria: thanks all. Closing loop for now — please add short status notes to the PRs/issue so I can track progress and surface to PMs.

maria: (config snippet captured during debug for reference)
```
# example: accidental route rule in LB template
route:
  - match: host_suffix: svc-redwood.example
    backend: pool-old
```

sam: FYI hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/791 — removed pool-old mapping and added a unit test.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment completed by sam at 2026-03-04T10:39:03Z :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll follow up after the 1-week check-in with a summary and any timeline adjustments. Thanks everyone.
